name: knob
description: Rotary control over a native range input: drag, wheel and keyboard turning, a token-drawn value arc (unipolar or bipolar), sizes, form participation and l-model support

label.description: Visible name, a <label for> pointing at the input

control.description: The round hit area: takes the pointer drag, the wheel and the double-click, and draws the focus ring while the input has keyboard focus

input.description: A native <input type="range"> carrying name, min, max, step and value. It is the focusable, accessible slider, the form field and the l-model target; it lies invisibly over the dial, and is the visible control when scripting is off

cap.description: The knob body inside the ring (decorative, aria-hidden)

dial.description: aria-hidden SVG (viewBox 0 0 100 100) holding the track, arc and indicator

scale.description: Optional tick scale: an arc just outside the track (pathLength="100") drawn as eleven dots

track.description: The 270° sweep, a path with pathLength="100"

arc.description: The same path, dashed by the stylesheet from --knob-origin to --knob-pos

indicator.description: The pointer line on the cap, rotated to the value

output.description: Visible value readout, written by the controller with the same text as aria-valuetext (aria-hidden, so the value is not announced twice)

dragging.description: A pointer drag is in progress; the glide transition is off so the dial tracks the pointer

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Set the value (snapped and clamped); fires `input` and `change`.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: The current value as a number.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Return to the authored default (the input's `value` attribute).

methods.name: setFormatter
methods.description: Format the readout and aria-valuetext: `fn(value) → string`, or null.

valueSuffix.description: Appended to the value in the readout and aria-valuetext ("%", " Hz", " dB")

origin.description: Bipolar mode: the value the arc grows out of (0 on a −12…12 range). Values above it read with a plus sign

drag.description: linear: drag up or right to turn clockwise (200px for the whole sweep, Shift for ten times finer). angular: the knob follows the pointer's angle around its centre

required_attrs: a <label for> or aria-label naming the input

keyboard.PageUp: increase by the page step (data-page-step, default 10 × step)

notes: The native <input type="range"> is the slider: implicit role="slider", native aria-valuenow/min/max from its value/min/max, and aria-valuetext kept by the controller from the readout text.
Pointer: drag up or right to increase (Shift for fine); double-click restores the default value. The wheel turns the knob only while it has focus, so a page scrolled past a knob keeps scrolling.
Every user change fires native input and change events on the input, so forms, listeners and l-model see a knob exactly as they see a range.
Disable with the input's own disabled attribute: it leaves the tab order and the form submission, and only the dial dims.
With scripting off the native range is shown in place of the dial.

The controller writes --knob-pos (0–1 along the sweep) and, for a bipolar knob, --knob-origin on the root. Author both inline (style="--knob-pos: 0.42") so the page paints the right dial before the controller runs.

templates.html: {value}{suffix}
templates.bipolar: 0 dB
